oracle: Published ai@7.0.166. Every fixture starts from initialMessage or {id:"m",role:"assistant",parts:[]}. Expected foldedMessage is last readUIMessageStream snapshot, with JSON serialization omitting undefined. sidecars describe observed finish/abort/transient events and normalized onError callbacks; they are not UIMessage properties. The default read helper continues after an explicit error chunk; useChat has a throwing error policy. Unless network_chunks_base64 is present, raw_utf8 is supplied in one network read. Encoded escapes in raw_utf8 denote literal UTF-8 bytes after JSON decoding.

interpretation.raw_utf8: Decode this JSON string, then encode as UTF-8 without adding bytes. It contains the complete wire input, including exact CR/LF framing.
interpretation.network_chunks_utf8: When present, supply the UTF-8 encoding of each array item as one network read. This can affect malformed legacy-v4 behavior.
interpretation.network_chunks_base64: When present, base64-decode each item and supply it as one read. This represents splits inside UTF-8 code points.
interpretation.default_network_partition: If neither network chunk field is present, deliver raw_utf8 as one network read.
interpretation.ESTABLISHED: Observed behavior of the cited published upstream package. Malformed-input examples need not be protocol-conforming; their decoder behavior is established.
interpretation.expected: foldedMessage is the profile-specific cumulative assistant-message projection; sidecars hold hook/run/transport observations, not additional standard wire fields.
interpretation.scope: Published upstream oracle behavior, not a claim that every case is protocol-conforming or that the Rust implementation passes it. No live backend or rendered UI is exercised.
